exposure.needed: which monitoring systems or alerting rules actively reference the old metric name lbipam_ips_available_total at runtime

original.statement: The metric lbipam_ips_available_total has been renamed to lbipam_ips_available.

decision.reason: [ev-875bb56564b0] only says that the metric `lbipam_ips_available_total` is renamed to `lbipam_ips_available`. The surrounding Changed Metrics section ([ev-2e2ab2d37845], [ev-1bf87d491deb]) names no Helm value, flag, field or resource that would show which environments are affected. Exposure depends on whether outside consumers (Prometheus queries, dashboards, alert rules) look up the old name. That is outside the product's configuration, so an undecidable leaf naming that need is appropriate. A predicate on a single resource kind (e.g. PrometheusRule expressions) would miss other consumers, so it would be too narrow.
